skill.summary: Supports active nonfiction reading through purpose setting, claim tracking, and application reflection.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Nonfiction Reading Companion skill.
- Supports active nonfiction reading through purpose setting, claim tracking, and reflection prompts.
- Guides users to clarify reading goals, track claims/evidence, and summarize concept notes.
- Offers structured outputs for progress review and planning next steps.
- Embeds clear safety measures: no book recommendations, no reproduction of full texts, and no formal academic grading.
